items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: It was Billie Holiday recording date with Benny Goodman, Walter Page, Buck Clayton, Freddie Green , Mr. Teddy Wilson, and myself.

ctx.x: You made this recording for John Hammond produced this? Producers?

I'm pretty sure Brunswick. It was Billie Holiday recording date with Benny Goodman, Walter Page, Buck Clayton, Freddie Green , Mr. Teddy Wilson, and myself. That's all that was on that, and Shoeless Joe Jackson, that's what they called him... Benny Goodman.
You don't remember one name of one of the tunes, do you?
